mapper.select: SELECT member_agent_id 'childId', member_user_id 'parentId' FROM agent_member_info WHERE agent_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.id, nickname, account_type, l.level_val, l.level_name, agent_id, (SELECT nickname FROM user_info i WHERE i.id = u.agent_id) AS agentName, general_agent_id, (SELECT nickname FROM user_info i WHERE i.id = u.general_agent_id) AS generalAgentName, (select count(1) from user_info i where i.reg_invitation_code=u.promotion_code) as inviteesCount, (select count(1) from agent_member_info am where am.agent_id=u.id) as memberCount, promotion_code, promotion_enable, reg_invitation_code, (select count(1) from user_info ui inner join level_def li on ui.level_id=li.id where ui.id in (select member_user_id from agent_member_info where agent_id=u.id) and li.level_val < l.level_val) as rebateCount
FROM user_info u INNER JOIN level_def l ON u.level_id = l.id
u.id=#{param.userId} and
u.account_type=#{param.accountType} and
u.level_id=#{param.levelId} and
u.agent_id=#{param.agentId} and
u.general_agent_id=#{param.generalAgentId} and
u.promotion_enable = 1
u.promotion_enable = 0
order by id

SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.account_type, u.level_id, u.agent_id, u.general_agent_id, (SELECT nickname FROM user_info i WHERE i.id = u.general_agent_id) AS generalAgentName, (select nickname from user_info where id=u.agent_id) as agentName, u.general_agent_id, u.real_auth_status, u.real_name, u.promotion_code, u.available_amt, u.follow_amt, u.follow_enable, u.login_enable, u.reg_time, u.last_login_time, u.reg_invitation_code, u.trading_frozen_amt, u.detention_amt, u.funding_status, l.level_val, l.level_name, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount_received), 0) FROM user_stock_closing_position WHERE stock_type IN ('sh' , 'sz', 'bj', 'us') and user_id=u.id AND transaction_status = 1 AND transaction_time > DATE_SUB(SYSDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) + (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount_received), 0) FROM user_stock_closing_position WHERE stock_type = 'hk' and user_id=u.id AND transaction_status = 1 AND transaction_time > DATE_SUB(SYSDATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY)) as unavailableWithdrawalAmt FROM user_info u INNER JOIN level_def l ON u.level_id = l.id
u.id=#{param.id} and
u.account_type=#{param.accountType} and
u.id in and
u.agent_id=#{param.agentId} and
u.real_name like '%${param.realName}%' and
u.reg_invitation_code like '%${param.invitationCode}%' and
concat(u.area_code,u.phone) like '%${param.phone}%' and
u.email like '%${param.email}%' and
u.login_enable=#{param.loginEnable} and
u.real_auth_status=#{param.realAuthStatus} and
u.funding_status=#{param.fundingStatus} and
u.reg_time >= #{param.regTimeStart} and
u.reg_time <= #{param.regTimeEnd} and
u.last_login_time >= #{param.lastLoginTimeStart} and
u.last_login_time <= #{param.lastLoginTimeEnd} and
order by
u.reg_time
u.available_amt
u.last_login_time
desc

SELECT userInfo.*, levelDef.level_val, levelDef.level_name,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN followRecord.follow_status != 2 THEN followRecord.id END) AS active_follow_count,
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN followRecord.follow_status != 2 THEN followRecord.initial_follow_sum END), 0) AS active_initial_sum,
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN followRecord.follow_status != 2 THEN followRecord.current_follow_sum END), 0) AS active_current_sum,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN followRecord.follow_status != 2 THEN followRecord.tutor_id END) AS active_tutor_count,
COUNT(followRecord.id) AS total_follow_count,
COALESCE(SUM(followRecord.initial_follow_sum), 0) AS total_initial_sum,
COALESCE(SUM(followRecord.return_follow_sum), 0) AS total_return_sum,
COALESCE(SUM(followRecord.tutor_commission), 0) AS total_tutor_commission,
COALESCE(SUM(followRecord.platform_commission), 0) AS total_platform_commission FROM user_info AS userInfo LEFT JOIN user_follow_up_record AS followRecord ON userInfo.id = followRecord.user_id LEFT JOIN level_def levelDef ON userInfo.level_id = levelDef.id
AND followRecord.follow_start_time >= #{param.startTime}
AND followRecord.follow_start_time <= #{param.endTime}
userInfo.id = #{param.userId} and
GROUP BY userInfo.id
